hypotheses.reasoning: payment-svc rolled out v1.10.0 at 02:16:24 (#1539). Its log at #1582 says 'response serializer v2 enabled', and from then on payment responses carry keys id/state/updatedAt with no 'status' field. order-service then fails to map every charge response: #1601 'unexpected payload, cannot map status', #1671 'missing required field status', #1755 schema validation error on payment reply, #1804 same mapping failure. order-service errors propagate upstream, so api-gateway's POST /checkout 502s (#1686, #1700, #1808, #2007, #2062) follow. Charges before the rollout (#1599 etc.) succeeded, matching the onset. The 502s are downstream symptoms and are not cited as causes. The account-svc/auth-svc ECONNREFUSED errors and /login 503s are a separate issue affecting login, not checkout. billing-reconciler checksum errors are unrelated archive noise.

auth-svc connection refused from account-svc (endpoint 10.33.162.6:8081) causes /login 503s. This is a real but separate fault that does not explain the POST /checkout 502s. Ruled out as the checkout cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back payment-svc from v1.10.0 to v1.9.1 (or disable the response serializer v2 setting) so payment responses include the 'status' field again. Then confirm order-service decode errors stop and checkout 502s drop. Separately, investigate auth-svc being unreachable (connection refused on 10.33.162.6:8081) behind the /login 503s. Review the dead-lettered order message msg-768737 (missing 'version' field) before requeueing it.
